QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_58

question.text: Vishesh AIF pays Trusteeship Fees of INR 3 lakh per year. GST at 18% applies. Total annual cost to the fund for trusteeship (incl. GST):

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states GST at 18% applies to Trusteeship Fees and Example 9.6 grosses up the trusteeship fee by GST. Trusteeship fee = INR 3 lakh; GST 18% = 3 x 0.18 = 0.54 lakh; Total fund cost = INR 3.54 lakh. The Trap: Option A ignores GST. Option B applies an incorrect rate. Option D rounds upward incorrectly. Note: GST increases the all-in cost of trusteeship services to the fund and should be reflected in the fund's expense schedule.
